summary: T-0767's review (docs/tasks/T-0767.spec.md §6) surfaced but explicitly deferred: loadAdminContext step 3 (src/db/org.ts) — the query that loads delegable mgmt_object:* grants for each of an actor's confirmed role assignments, consumed by ~11 seed-write mgmt paths (assertOrgObjectAuthority/validateAdminDelegation) plus artifacts.ts's tier-promote gate, secret-handle.ts, llm-config.ts, seed-write.ts, agents.ts, user-mgmt.ts, rights-intents.ts — carried NO confirmed_by/confirmed2_by predicate on the grant row at ALL, unlike the canonical getGrantsForSubject step 3 (grants-dao.ts) which enforces the T-0397 grant-row dual-control predicate correctly. UNLIKE T-0767's assignment-row axis (dormant — no live write path sets proposed_by), this is a LIVE single-confirmation bypass: a CRITICAL mgmt_object:* grant (criticalGrantPredicate axis a — e.g. mgmt_object:tier_promote/transition, the exact literal artifacts.ts's real consumer checks) proposed via POST /api/grants lands semi-confirmed (confirmed_by=first approver, confirmed2_by=NULL) via grants.ts's live escalating-branch INSERT today, and reached adminGrants unfiltered before this fix — authorizing on one confirmation instead of the required two. A second, defence-in-depth failure mode was also found and closed: any grant with confirmed_by IS NULL (never confirmed at all) was ALSO admitted regardless of criticality. Fix mirrors the T-0675 precedent exactly (report-page-render.ts's application/read gate had the identical missing-predicate bug, closed by importing and reusing the SAME exported criticalGrantPredicate(alias) classifier rather than re-deriving the four escalation axes): loadAdminContext step 3 now appends `g.confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND (NOT criticalGrantPredicate("g") OR g.confirmed2_by IS NOT NULL)`. Non-critical delegable mgmt_object:* grants are unaffected (NOT criticalGrantPredicate short-circuits the OR). Running the full fitness:db suite after the fix surfaced 3 pre-existing test fixtures (T-0645, schema_change_api_ac7b, user-mgmt T-0630) that seeded mgmt_object:* grants via raw INSERT omitting the confirmed_by column (defaulting to NULL) — unknowingly relying on the exact bug this task fixes; corrected by adding the missing confirmed_by/confirmed2_by columns with the codebase's standard 'seed' convention, with zero change to the tests' security assertion logic.

no_op_proof.static: criticalGrantPredicate(alias) is imported, not re-derived — byte-identical function call to the one getGrantsForSubject step 3 (grants-dao.ts) and report-page-render.ts's defaultCheckReadGrant (T-0675) already interpolate into their own grant-row queries. `NOT criticalGrantPredicate('g')` evaluates TRUE for every non-critical grant (all axes false), so `confirmed_by IS NOT NULL` is the ONLY new constraint on non-critical rows — every existing non-critical admin-grant fixture with confirmed_by set (T-0658/T-0767's mgmt_object:employee/update pattern; this task's own AC-2/AC-3 regression controls) is provably unaffected.
no_op_proof.live: T-0768-mgmt-grant-dual-control.db.test.ts AC-2 (non-critical confirmed grant) and AC-3 (fully dual-confirmed CRITICAL grant) both assert unchanged visibility in adminGrants, before AND after the fix. AC-4 additionally proves loadAdminContext and getGrantsForSubject resolve the IDENTICAL grant-id set for the same role — one source of truth, not two diverging implementations.
